title: Karl Wolfe run over before disclosure wave
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Karl Wolfe run over before disclosure wave, about 2017-2018 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: of so-called disclosure began in 2017, 2018, poor Carl Wolf was run over just the way John Mack was run over,

plain: A researcher and philosopher, Jason Jorjani, says on a podcast that around 2017 and 2018, just as the recent wave of disclosure began (the push for the US government to reveal what it knows about non-human intelligence), a man named Karl Wolfe was "run over" in the same way a man named John Mack was. Jorjani tells it as a sign that people tied to these questions were being pushed aside or harmed right when the subject went public.
